FORMAT_INFO: @Xn - this is a placeholder. after formatting, the value will be in its place
X - a modifier in the placeholder. The formatter must distinguish between the following modifiers:
q (quoted) - The value will be displayed in quotation marks: '10'
c (code) - The value will be displayed in the backticks: `10`
f (file) - the file ID is converted to a path: path/to/file
n (number) - The number will be colored if possible: [cyan]`10`
